role: Read-only vanilla Anvil region reader for checkpoint starts: RegionFile's 4 KiB sector table and zlib or gzip chunk stream, a binary NBT parser for the tag kinds a chunk carries, and the Level compound returned as a canonical nbt tree; also enumerates every chunk present in a save's region files.
gpu: line 45 and 256, functions inflate_zlib and region_load_chunk: malloc of the chunk's record and of the inflated chunk per load (the file itself is no longer read whole since lane/dense-arena: read_at preads the header entry and the record)
line 45-73, function inflate_zlib: unbounded retry loop doubling the output buffer until the stream fits
line 271-297, function region_load_chunk: the same unbounded doubling loop for gzip chunks
line 90-230, functions nbt_bin_compound and nbt_bin_value: mutual recursion over nested compounds and lists, depth-limited to 64
line 170, function nbt_bin_value: a 64 KiB name buffer a string tag, taken from the env's scratch stack (ENV_LOCAL)
line 321-349, function region_load_chunk: copies each Level field through nbt_copy_canonical, rendered and reparsed as text only where that copy declines
line 381-437, function region_enumerate: opens up to 4096 region files (rx, rz in -32..31) and grows the output with realloc
notes: Called only from serverreplay.c's checkpoint start (--from), before any tick runs. Chunks outside region rx/rz -32..31 (block coordinates beyond about +-32768) are not enumerated. Tag type 12 (long array) is parsed though 1.7.10 never writes it. region_level_terrain_populated reads only TerrainPopulated; the header's mention of LastUpdate is not implemented here. test_snapshots.c exercises it only through checkpoint snapshots (cp-*), which I did not confirm run in the default suite.
